description: The shared preset (KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config) brings Renovate's best practices, the Monday-morning window, the 3-day release age, the prek.toml hook revs, the labels, and the rule leaving the github-workflows pins to its release propagation. Only this repository's own rules follow: its extra pin formats, its two groups and its checksum-pinned tools.

customManagers.description: Bump the proto toolchain pins in config/proto/.prototools (Renovate has no native proto manager). Each `<tool> = "<version>"` line is annotated with a `# renovate:` comment carrying its datasource/depName.

Bump the pinned helm, proto, k9s and Git Credential Manager releases, and the Kubernetes apt channel of kubectl. Each `local version="…"` line is annotated with a `# renovate:` comment. The SHA-256 pinned next to it is not updated: the install fails closed until the sums are copied, as the PR body says.

packageRules.description: The prek hooks in one pull request of their own, outside the preset's weekly group.
The proto toolchain (bun, node, pnpm, yarn…) in one pull request of its own.

helm, proto, k9s and Git Credential Manager pin a SHA-256 per platform next to the version: a version bump alone makes the install refuse the new tarball. One pull request each, outside the preset's weekly group: the sums are copied by hand, one release at a time.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Update the SHA-256 pins next to the version before merging, or the install refuses the new release: copy them from the release (helm: `https://get.helm.sh/helm-<version>-linux-<arch>.tar.gz.sha256sum`; proto, k9s, Git Credential Manager: the `digest` of each asset on the GitHub release).

packageRules.description: The kubectl apt repository (pkgs.k8s.io) exists per Kubernetes minor, so the pin is `v<major>.<minor>`: each full release tag maps to its minor and pre-releases match nothing. One pull request per new minor, none for patches.
